g.text: PrefetchingReader — producer thread, bounded channel, and the three exits
steady state — the producer runs ahead
channel holds B batches, so the producer can
never run more than B·S sentences ahead.
Done ⇒ exhausted = true ⇒ Iterator returns None
Error ⇒ log::error! ⇒ iteration ends (no unwind in the consumer)
drain with try_recv() to unblock a blocked send
Drop runs this sequence automatically. Draining
joining is what prevents the classic deadlock: a producer
parked inside a blocking send() on a full channel can only
observe the stop flag after a receive frees a slot.
